description: Draft objects from local OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Postgres DDL/migrations, Prisma, dbt, OData or GraphQL files. Use it when importing a schema you already have; use object_registry for hand-written object/trait YAML. Returns an importId, staged drafts/report, counts and a re-import diff. action=draft uses source.path or source.content without registering; show uses importId and object for YAML, graded proposals and unmapped elements; apply uses importId and explicit objects with accepted proposal ids. The batch validates and composes with rollback. overwrite replaces team objects; confirmShipped names each approved shipped replacement. Unreachable references are reported and skipped; no network fetch or code execution. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#object_import; full schema: oods://schemas/object_import.input.json.

action.description: Draft files without registration; show one draft; apply explicitly accepted objects and proposals.

confirmShipped.description: Each shipped object name whose replacement is explicitly confirmed.

importId.description: Content-addressed import id from draft. Required by show and apply.

object.description: Exact draft object name for show.

objects.description: Explicit accepted object names and optional proposal ids for apply.

items.description: objects item. Fields: name, proposals. See full schema.

source.description: Local file/folder or inline schema. Used only by draft.

content.description: Inline schema text, at most 1 MiB. Set format for SQL, Prisma, OData XML or GraphQL SDL.

format.description: Explicit source format; inferred from file extension or document when omitted.

name.description: File name for inline provenance; no directories.

path.description: Local file or folder. References must stay inside the source folder. Aggregate limit 128 MiB.

name: object_import
title: Import Objects
